Winery Description: BORNOS Vinos & Licores is the meeting point for a new era in the world of wine, where our passion for it translates into innovation and authenticity, merging history with the future. Each of our wineries and their brands come together under a concept that challenges the conventional. While preserving their character, personality, and identity, they are all guided by a unique philosophy. And we do so with a specific goal in mind: to elevate everything we expect from wine through quality, continuous improvement, and excellence, always thinking about what the consumer seeks at every moment. Currently, we bring together seven wineries rooted in six prestigious wine regions of Spain: Palacio de Bornos (D.O. Rueda), Señorío de Sarría (D.O. Navarra), Lleiroso and Dominio de Bornos (D.O. Ribera del Duero), Martínez Corta (D.O.Ca. Rioja), Bucrana (D.O. Toro), and Guelbenzu (Finca la Lombana). To all of this, we add the spirits we produce at Casa D’Aristi, originating from Mexico.

Product 1 Name: Palacio de Bornos Verdejo Colección de Familia Sergio Hernández
Product 1 Description: Family Collection is a range of limited editions where wine and art come together through the work, passion and inspiration of the winemaker in the cellar and the artist in the studio. In each edition, a winery, an origin and a prestigious artist come together in a unique dialogue, but under the same vision: to create a unique and captivating work that is both wine and art culture. The label of Palacio de Bornos Gran Vino de Rueda Edición Sergio Hernández reproduces the work of the renowned Mexican artist, reflecting, thanks to his unmistakable style full of luminosity and liveliness, the origin of wine: the grape, the bunch. Verdejo from old bush vines, double grape selection, fermentation in ceramic amphorae, ageing on lees for nine months and prolonged subsequent rest in the bottle make this wine something extraordinary, creating an unforgettable sensation that leaves its mark.
Product 2 Description: It shows a pale yellow color with greenish reflections. On the nose, it offers high aromatic intensity, marked by a wide range of varietal aromas—hay, balsamic notes, and citrus—along with a hint of maturity contributed by the lees aging. On the palate, it has good structure, presenting itself as balanced, smooth, and velvety, with a long finish that recalls the aromas perceived on the nose.
Product 3 Description: It has an intense cherry red colour with ruby reflections, with a high layer, clean and bright. On the nose it offers a high aromatic intensity, where ripe black fruit is elegantly integrated with notes of wood, spices, cloves, smoky nuances and a delicate background of liquorice. On the palate it is voluminous, round and velvety, with a balanced and very pleasant mid-palate, which leads to a long and persistent aftertaste.
Product 4 Name: Lleiroso Colección de Familia Joan Miró
Product 4 Description: This wine is made in harmony with the painter Joan Miró, creator of the artwork featured on the label of this magnificent Reserva. It is made from 100% Tempranillo sourced from old vines, with a strict selection of grapes both in the vineyard and upon arrival at the winery. Aged for eighteen months in new French oak barrels, it displays an intense ruby-red color with a high layer and dense tears. It offers an intense aroma with notes of ripe and candied red fruit, complemented by toasted nuances from the barrel. On the palate, it is powerful, expressive, and elegant, with characteristic balsamic touches that reflect the mineral-rich area where it originates.
Product 5 Description: It displays a raspberry red color. On the nose, it offers intense aromas of wild berries such as currants, raspberries, and strawberries, accompanied by delicate milky and floral notes, especially violets. On the palate, it is fresh, flavorful, and luscious, with red fruit flavors combined with milky hints reminiscent of wild berry yogurt, resulting in a broad, persistent, and very pleasant finish.
Product 6 Description: It shows an intense cherry red color. On the nose, it offers powerful aromas of ripe black fruit, perfectly integrated with toasted and spicy notes and a balsamic finish. On the palate, it is powerful and structured, with flavors of ripe black fruit, spices, and balsamic hints combined with round tannins, revealing a wide range of nuances and complexity. The finish is long, persistent, elegant, and well-rounded.
Product 7 Description: It displays a cherry red color with garnet hues. On the nose, it shows intense aromas of red and black fruit, accompanied by floral and spicy notes, with a balsamic finish that adds freshness. On the palate, it is flavorful, fresh, and well-balanced, with pronounced fruity and spicy character complemented by creamy nuances, vanilla, and subtle toasted notes, revealing power and good structure.
Product 8 Description: It shows an intense cherry red color with purple hues and a medium-high layer. On the nose, it is very expressive and harmonious, with aromas of black fruit, aniseed notes, balsamic hints, and mineral nuances. On the palate, it is structured and balanced, with soft, sweet tannins, finishing with a long and silky aftertaste.
Product 9 Description: Made from Verdejo grapes and fermented in isobaric tanks to maintain its natural effervescence. It has a pale yellow color with light green highlights. Intense aromas of citrus, peach and tropical fruits stand out on the nose. The palate is fresh, with a marked presence of carbon dioxide and an excellent balance between acidity and sweetness.
Product 10 Description: Narano captures the bright, spicy profile of the Yucatan's endemic bitter orange, a common and versatile fruit that grows in the region and is often used in local cuisine, for example, in marinades or sauces. Its acidic touch, together with its herbaceous notes, make it very accessible in a wide range of cocktails to which it adds a citrus touch. Perfect for an all-Mexican margarita.

Winery Description: Les Freses Winery is a Boutique winery focused on estate certified organic grapes to produce wines from endemic Valencian varieties under the Alicante appellation where our ancestors had cultivated them for millennia, situated between Dénia and Jávea on the Spanish Levant. Our goal: Mediterranean freshness, full in your palate, low-alcohol and light fresh wines.
Trade Show Location: Montjuïc, Pavilion 8, Level 0, Street F, Stand 288
Product 1 Description: VITICULTURA 100% moscatel de Alejandría plantado en espaldera a doble guyot sobre suelos arcillosos, con una producción media por hectárea de 4000 kg/ha. Este viñedo de 17 años de 6 ha, solo recibe enmiendas naturales y además de una poda en seco, continuas podas en verde. Vendimiamos manualmente en cajas de 12kg con mesa de selección y despalillado la primera semana de agosto. ELABORACIÓN Y CRIANZA Tras una maceración de 24 h, arranca la fermentación con levaduras propias y la mantenemos con la temperatura controlada a 15ºC en depósitos de inox. Con una ligera filtración y un nivel de sulfitos bajo. NOTAS DE CATA En visual es amarillo pajizo claro, brillante y con reflejos verdes típicos de la moscatel y en nariz es un moscatel lleno de flores frescas, jazmín, flor de azahar, manzanilla, rosa y polvos de talco. En boca, seco totalmente, placentero, citrico con limoncillo, pétalos carnosos y su retrogusto es largo en boca, de hinojo, jengibre y pimienta blanca, salino y toque a pomelo.
Product 2 Description: Una vinificación al estilo de los íberos de s VII ac que colonizaron nuestra comarca, para ofrecer un vino muy de hoy. Un vino que busca ser el mejor reconocimiento a nuestros antepasados y a nuestra tierra. Un visual de oro, limpio y con reflejos brillantes pajizos. Intenso y distinguido con aromas florales en nariz. Complejo, seco y salino en banco.
Product 3 Description: Vinificación sobre lías en damajuanas de 54L.
Product 4 Description: De una pequeña parcela de viñas de más de 70 años, la moscatel se vuelve sabia y tranquila.
Product 5 Description: Las viñas viejas de 70 años nos dan muy pocos racimos que fermentaremos en barricas de roble.
Product 6 Description: Uvas de moscatel, pasificadas en la planta, para un dulce lleno de frutos secos, orejones y mucha tensión.
Product 7 Description: Un coupage 100% valenciano: Giró, Forcallat, Monastrell, Bobal y Tardana. Baja graduación y cuerpo.
Product 8 Description: 100% giró, la garnacha de nuestra comarca, más ligera y menos alcohólica.
Product 9 Description: La variedad Forcallat nos encanta: poco tanino y mucha fruta, poco alcohol y muchas posibilidades de maridaje.
Product 10 Description: In our obsession to find the happiest Muscat vines in our region, we found an "albino" Hamburg Muscat or pink Muscat plant and began vinification soon there after. The Muscat grape family includes about two hundred varieties of the Vitis vinifera grape. The breadth and number of Muscat varieties suggest that it may be the oldest cultivated grape variety in the world, thus an aspiration of Les Freses. After more than twelve years and a huge amount of work by our botanist friend Jaume X. Soler in the laboratory, we managed to plant a vineyard of 400 plants with which we vinify this still rosé on the estate.
